purpose: Test whether local measured precipitation at the Palomar Mountain Observatory GHCN station is associated with Palomar observing opportunity or with POSS-I S0 candidate rate conditional on actual observation.

weather_source.dry_semantics: QA-clean PRCP == 0 means no measured daily precipitation at this station; it does not mean clear sky.
weather_source.missing_semantics: Missing or quality-flagged PRCP is excluded, never coerced to zero.

date_alignment.primary: weather_date = Palomar UTC observation/calendar date minus 1 civil day
date_alignment.rationale: POSS plate DATE-OBS is interpreted in UT and much Palomar night observing begins on the preceding local civil date; GHCN is a local daily climate summary rather than exposure-hour weather.
date_alignment.sensitivity: weather_date = same nominal Palomar UTC date
date_alignment.boundary: Neither alignment is claimed to reconstruct exposure-hour cloud conditions.

primary_endpoints.unit: calendar day in the frozen 1949-11-19..1957-04-28 UTC study grid with QA-clean aligned PRCP
primary_endpoints.model: logistic observed_night ~ wet_day + month fixed effects + year fixed effects

primary_endpoints.unit: actually observed Palomar night with QA-clean aligned PRCP
primary_endpoints.model: NB2 candidate_count ~ wet_day + month/year + sky footprint + exposure/WCS + lunar illumination + GFZ Ap/Kp, offset log(tile_count)
primary_endpoints.interpretation: Candidate-rate/acquisition-quality association only; not physical-origin inference.

frozen_sensitivity.role: sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed primary minus-1-day alignment

admission_rule.weather_association_candidate: P2 primary wet-day coefficient p<0.05 and finite CI; retained only as an acquisition/quality association, not an origin mechanism.
admission_rule.schedule_only: If P1 is associated but P2 is not, classify as weather-linked observing opportunity without residual candidate-rate effect.
admission_rule.null: If P1 and P2 are non-significant, classify as no detected wet-day association under this daily-summary alignment.

forbidden: PRCP=0 may not be called clear sky.
Missing weather may not be called dry weather.
Unobserved Palomar days may not enter P2 as candidate_count=0.
A weather coefficient may not identify candidate physical origin.
The same-date sensitivity may not override a failed primary alignment.
No Blue Book witness-local weather inference is made from the Palomar station.
